weapons.name: Juzumaru
weapons.description:
A sword made by the swordsmith Aoe Tsunetsugu.
It's said that the priest Nichiren used it as spiritual protection.

weapons.description:
Ito's beloved sword, signed by "Kanesada."

"Nine Hand Seals."

weapons.acquisitionText: You receive it during the main story in 12-2.

weapons.name: Bullet-Cutter Kanemitsu
weapons.description:
A famous sword made by "Kanemitsu."
Its name comes from an anecdote in which it supposedly sliced through
both a gun and the arm holding it.
weapons.acquisitionHtml: Defeat Amon in Request #100. See details.
weapons.acquisitionText: Defeat Amon in Request #100. See details .

weapons.name: Peerless Tachi
weapons.description:
An unrivaled tachi bearing the inscription "Tenka."
It appears to have been forged alongside a matching wakizashi marked "Muso."
When combined, "Tenka Muso" means "Unrivaled Under the Heavens."

weapons.acquisitionText: Learn all 60 abilities. See details .

weapons.name: Beckoning Sword
weapons.description:
A katana said to "draw in people."

weapons.name: Drunken Blade
weapons.description:
A sword that gets stronger the more drunk you get.
I'd rather not rely on alcohol, or an enchanted sword, to become stronger.

weapons.description:
